description: This source file defines the WorkActivityStore class, which manages the state of activities such as jobs and tools within an application. It tracks activity sessions, handles their lifecycle events, and derives UI-related states like icon displays. The class also includes logic for managing session keys and activity roles, and interacts with external components for tool display and protocol handling.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the activity states (jobs and tools), session keys, and icon representations for an application.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A data structure representing an activity session with information like session key, role, kind, label, and timestamps.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Handles the start or end of a job activity based on session key and state.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Manages tool activity sessions, initiating or concluding tool overlays with associated metadata.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Updates the icon state representation based on a given override selection.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and trims the main session key used as a priority activity.
